method: test-only AutoSyncProbe: seeds a pairing plus a sync_cursor, starts a libp2p server inside the same process on port 47960, then calls the production AutoSync.runOnce

observed.logcat: AUTO_SYNC_PROBE outcome=completed with probe-3b191927e58a5071 applied=0 cursor=127.0.0.1:47960 ok:0
what_it_proves: AutoSync picks an active pairing and reads its sync_cursor
it dials the stored loopback address and port through SyncTransport.nativeDialOnce
it merges the response with SyncRecords.merge
it writes the result back to sync_cursor (ok:0)

limitations: the probe's server identity resolved to the same peer id as the app (appPeer=00240801, serverPeer=00240801), so this is a self-dial: it proves the wiring, not multi-peer semantics
applied=0 because both sides read and wrote the same store
the earlier two-package attempt failed on the 60-second pairing window, so a real cross-package transfer is still unverified
